migration.instruction: Use searchEvidence (or the legacy search array adapter) plus evidence-only extract returning exact source and quote fields. Extract-only hidden research is no longer run; explicit research must return SearchResult. Use discoverContactsWithEvidence to distinguish unavailable from empty. Contact deduplication preserves distinct company/profile/role identities.

changes.summary: Require source-bound contact extraction, preserve discovery status, strengthen identity merging and bound/coalesce dataset caching
